init.title: OpenIOTAI – Settings
init.description: Configure how Home Assistant publishes data to the OpenIOTAI service via MQTT.

data_description.mqtt_broker: Hostname or IP address of the MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_port: Network port of the MQTT broker (typically 8883 for TLS).
data_description.mqtt_topic: MQTT topic under which data is published.
data_description.mqtt_username: Username used to authenticate with the MQTT broker.
data_description.mqtt_ca_cert: PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the broker.
data_description.publish_interval: How often data is published, in seconds.
